text.en: Refresh artwork across the built-in custom plugins and their workbenches.
text.zh-CN: 更新随包自定义插件及工作台图标。

text.en: Check for independent Style Prompt and Boot Animation plugin updates from the Plugins page.
text.zh-CN: 插件页支持检查风格提示词和启动动画的独立更新。

text.en: Windows installer downloads use bounded parallel requests on supported sources and retain verified progress across pauses, source changes and restarts.
text.zh-CN: Windows 安装包在支持的线路使用有上限的并行下载，暂停、换源和重启后保留经过校验的进度。

text.en: Plugin downloads can continue while data is arriving instead of timing out after a fixed total duration, and show measured percentages in lists and details.
text.zh-CN: 修复插件安装包持续下载时仍因固定总时限而超时的问题，列表和详情同步显示真实下载百分比。

text.en: Play the cyberpunk intro while the workspace and initial data load, with skip and reduced-motion support.
text.zh-CN: 启动时在工作区和首批数据加载期间播放赛博朋克片头，支持跳过和减少动态效果。

text.en: Read new features, improvements and bug fixes in the desktop update dialog while the download continues.
text.zh-CN: 桌面更新弹窗新增更新说明，可在下载时查看新增功能、体验优化和问题修复。

text.en: Let the selected native model manage Visual Curator request timing, and refresh conversation cards when tasks finish.
text.zh-CN: 视觉策展的原生模型请求交由所选模型管理时序，并在任务结束时刷新会话卡片。
